visual_language.medium: Hand-illuminated fantasy codex art: opaque mineral and gouache-like pigment, iron-gall/woodcut ink line, translucent colored glazing, and selective gold-leaf or phosphor-like accents on parchment and vellum.
visual_language.surface: Warm parchment/vellum tooth remains visible through flat pigment, ink hatching, rubbed color, gilded borders, and translucent night washes; the image should feel authored onto a page rather than rendered into a seamless digital surface.
visual_language.mark_making: Heraldic blocks, carved/hatched ink, runic penwork, manuscript ornament, haloed washes, and small luminous glyphs; each family handles the common codex material differently while remaining visibly from one Britannian book.
visual_language.signature_accent: Selective gold leaf, ankh/rune illumination, moon-silver, and moongate phosphor provide sacred or magical highlights without turning the whole deck glossy.
visual_language.finish: Mythic early-RPG manual meets medieval illuminated manuscript: tactile, hieratic, slightly flattened, materially handmade, and readable at card scale while retaining atmosphere.
avoid: generic anime or modern game-concept-art polish
uniform digital gradients that erase parchment and ink texture
one identical composition language across all four suits
